# Without git, sesam refuses to run unless --allow-no-git (or
# SESAM_ALLOW_NO_GIT=true) allows it. Then read-only commands work, minus the
# git based checks, and git-only commands still fail right away.
#
# Every command that touches a repo is listed here. Not listed, as they never
# open one: help, --version, keyring clear, unclip, rotate.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec sesam add secret.txt
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add secret'

# A deployment that got the files, but not the history.
rm .git
rm secret.txt

# --- without the flag everything stops, with a hint ---

! exec sesam ls
stderr 'no git repository found'
stderr 'use --allow-no-git if that''s ok'

! exec sesam show secret.txt
stderr 'use --allow-no-git if that''s ok'

! exec sesam status
stderr 'use --allow-no-git if that''s ok'

# --- the flag works before and after the command ---

exec sesam --allow-no-git ls
stdout 'secret.txt'

exec sesam ls --allow-no-git
stdout 'secret.txt'

env SESAM_ALLOW_NO_GIT=true

# --- read-only commands work ---

exec sesam show secret.txt
stdout 's3cr3t'

exec sesam run --secret S=secret.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$S"'
stdout 's3cr3t'

exec sesam log
stdout 'added secret.txt'

exec sesam id
stdout 'admin'

exec sesam user list
stdout 'admin'

exec sesam config print
stdout 'secret.txt'

exec sesam verify
stderr 'Truncation: skipped \(no git\)'
stderr 'Integrity: ok'

exec sesam verify --all --json
stdout '"success": true'

exec sesam verify --integrity
stderr 'Integrity: ok'
! stderr 'Truncation'

exec sesam verify --key-reuse
stderr 'Key re-use: ok'

exec sesam verify --forge-check
stderr 'Forge Check: ok'

exec sesam reveal --all
exists secret.txt

# --- git-only commands fail right away ---

! exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam verify --config
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam reveal
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam reveal secret.txt
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam status
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam seal
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam add other.txt
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam rm secret.txt
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam mv secret.txt moved.txt
stderr 'this command needs git'

env EDITOR=true
! exec sesam edit secret.txt
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam kill --user admin
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam user change-groups --user admin --group dev
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam user add-recipient --user admin --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam user remove-recipient --user admin --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam user regen-sign-key --user admin
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam user rename admin root
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam config apply
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam config diff
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam config reset
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam apply
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam clean
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam clean --aggressive
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam init --user admin
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam uninstall
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam hook install
stderr 'this command needs git'

! exec sesam hook uninstall
stderr 'this command needs git'

# The merge drivers only run under git.
! exec sesam merge secret o a b 7 secret.txt
stderr 'no git repository'

! exec sesam merge log o a b 7 secret.txt
stderr 'no git repository'

# Hooks never block git: they warn and succeed.
exec sesam hook pre-commit
exec sesam hook post-checkout
exec sesam hook post-merge
exec sesam hook pre-merge-commit

# doctor reports the missing git as an issue, it does not crash.
! exec sesam doctor
stdout '# sesam doctor'

-- secret.txt --
s3cr3t
